I had a very very large job. Our house was a fixer upper and we needed new landscaping, decking, our pool was leaking and it was an overall mess.

Cody came in and really did a great work on it. We removed the old spa and put in a grotto which is beautiful and the kids love it. Literally built a whole new pool and backyard for us and a fire pit area and whole new fencing and turf.

It did not come without hiccups though as there was a lot of GC turnover on our job which required a lot more management on our end to ensure all the punch list items were done and done correctly. Our project took a lot longer than originally anticipated but it was worth the wait. I am also a small business owner and empathize with the aspect of finding honorable and hard working employees.

The pictures speak for themselves but lastly I will say this... the best decision of going with TPP was Cody and his integrity and customer service. EVERYTHING is above board and he will treat you fairly and right despite what is happening on the job. Things happen on jobs that aren't predicted, that is life. The way he treats you, responds, and makes things right brings me comfort.

I have heard nightmares of other pool companies ghosting or doing terrible work and not standing by it. You do not have that worry here.

They for sure need to up the communication and send change orders to prevent pricing confusions. We had some confusions but Cody made it right.

The only reason my job does not get 5 stars is because of the self management, timing and turnover of staff (which I think is a good thing long term for TPP). At the end of it, we have a beautiful backyard to enjoy and watch our kids grow up in and we we're treated fairly through the process. They are worth it.

They expertly removed two previous layers of plaster starting with manual removal then finishing with hydroblasting.  They retiled perfectly  and then replastered with the Pebble Sheen finish.  Each team of specialists who came to my house did everything perfectly, professionally and on time.  The hydroblast team even tidied up and cleaned my windows before they went to lunch!  Kudos to Cody Saliture for having such an amazing team of specialists and perfectionists!

reviews.text: I was clear to this company over the phone that I was not looking for regular pool maintenance, but rather just needed someone to come by once or twice and vacuum some sand out. They took my credit card information and sent an employee out the following weekend. When he showed up he began evaluating everything. I tried to explain to him that all I needed was the vacuuming and he informed me that he did not bring a vacuum with him. I told him he could go and I would call the office on Monday. On Monday I received a $30.00 invoice and a charge on my credit card for a $30.00 trip charge. I called the office and suggested that we just re-schedule the vacuuming. The secretary told me she would call back with a date. She called later that day to tell me that they had decided not to provide me service. I was very confused at this point.
